title: Guided reading: John 1:12
subtitle: Read relative clause, aorist, and dative in a real verse.
overview: This verse deliberately reuses forms you know: ὅσοι introduces a relative idea, ἔλαβον and ἔδωκεν are aorists, and αὐτοῖς is dative plural.
Read the grammar first; only then compare the smooth English translation.

sections.title: Form map
rows: he gave to them — aorist + dative
to become children of God — infinitive phrase

items.grc: ὅσοι δὲ ἔλαβον αὐτόν, ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τέκνα θεοῦ γενέσθαι.
items.en: But to all who received him, he gave authority to become children of God.

items.grc: τοῖς πιστεύουσιν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.
items.en: to those believing in his name.
